title: Customer Payment Record and the New Agreement Security Deposit Multiple
content:
**Credit rule for new agreements.** The multiple for a Security Deposit on a new agreement follows the customer's payment record on all its Electric Service Agreements in the 12 months ending on the assessment date, late payment charges being counted after deducting one for each courtesy late-charge waiver credit.

1. Where no late payment charge is counted and no payment reversal was posted, the multiple is the kind's deposit multiple less 0.5.
2. Where 2 or more late payment charges are counted or any payment reversal was posted, it is the kind's deposit multiple plus 0.5.
3. Otherwise it is the kind's deposit multiple.

## Multiples by kind

| Security Deposit kind | Kind's deposit multiple | Clean record | 2 or more counted, or a reversal | Otherwise (exactly 1 counted, no reversal) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Residential New Service Deposit | 2.0 | 1.5 | 2.5 | 2.0 |
| Small Commercial Service Deposit | 2.0 | 1.5 | 2.5 | 2.0 |
| Medium Commercial Service Deposit | 2.5 | 2.0 | 3.0 | 2.5 |
| Large Power Service Deposit | 2.0 | 1.5 | 2.5 | 2.0 |

## Truth table (hypothetical records across all of the customer's agreements)

| Late payment charges posted | Courtesy waiver credits | Counted | Payment reversals | Multiple |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | Less 0.5 |
| 2 | 2 | 0 | 0 | Less 0.5 |
| 1 | 0 | 1 | 0 | Kind's multiple |
| 3 | 1 | 2 | 0 | Plus 0.5 |
| 0 | 0 | 0 | 1 | Plus 0.5 |
